messages:
Maria G: Quick heads-up — during the new reranker bring-up I noticed NDCG dropping ~3pts vs prod on the MixBench split when we include the full candidate set (not just top-50). Anyone seen this before?
Yusuf K: Hmm, we changed candidate curation earlier — are duplicates filtered? that can skew NDCG if many near-duplicates push true positives down.
Maria G: Good call. I ran dedupe at title+snip and it moved +0.7 pts. Still ~2.3 down vs prod for int8 model.
Kevin Chen: Is the baseline using the same tokenization / doc truncation? Even a 32-token off-by can flip relevance for short queries.
Maria G: Baseline and new model used the same tokenizer config in the harness, but I found some docs were truncated at 1024 vs prod's 2048 for the candidate scoring step.
Nora P: That would definitely explain failures on long-context queries. Can you share the harness config snippet?
Maria G: Pasted config we used:
```
harness:
  dataset: mixbench-v2
  candidate_pool: all_candidates.json
  candidate_truncate: 1024
  metric: ndcg@10
  seed: 42
  dedupe: title_snip
```
Eva (ML): Also verify negative sampling: if the baseline removed near-duplicates or used stronger synthetic negatives, MRR/NDCG comparisons become apples-to-oranges. We should run an ablation: (A) exact candidate set + no dedupe, (B) with dedupe, (C) truncate 2048.
Yusuf K: Agree. Add per-query length buckets: short(<32), mid(32-128), long(>128) — that will show where the regression concentrates.
Kevin Chen: For the quantized model I want to check determinism. Run 3 seeds and compute bootstrap CI on NDCG difference. If the CI overlaps 0 maybe it's noise.
Maria G: Running those now on a smaller eval shard (5k queries). CI script: `python eval/ndcg_ci.py --runs 3 --bootstrap 1000 --metric ndcg@10`.
Maria G: Quick update — after switching truncate->2048 and removing dedupe we recover ~1.9 pts. Remaining gap looks concentrated in long queries.
ora p: small typo — my name's Nora P (caps) but ignore :)
ora p: For long queries let's check tokenization boundary: are we splitting doc windows differently? sometimes boundary handling causes mismatched contexts.
Eva (ML): Also compare top-k sensitivity: ndcg@5 vs ndcg@10 vs mrr. If dropout is mostly at depth >5 it's less severe.
Yusuf K: Can we also add a synthetic-noise test: append random sentence to docs to see if ranking reorders (detect overreliance on surface cues).
CI Bot: build #3445 finished — eval harness artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-dev/eval/run-2718234567/
Kevin Chen: Nice. Next steps: 1) full-run w/ 3 seeds 2) per-length buckets 3) top-k matrix 4) bootstrap CI 5) doc-window parity check. I can take items 1+4 today.
Maria G: Thanks Kevin. I'll own bucket breakdowns and candidate dedupe ablation. Will report back in this thread with numbers and plots (small PNGs). :thumbsup:
